environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance running Amazon Linux 2, Docker container with default seccomp profile disabled (--security-opt seccomp=unconfined). Container runs as root. The Flask app is behind an nginx reverse proxy that passes all request bodies unmodified. No AppArmor or SELinux enforcement (permissive mode). The container image includes wkhtmltopdf 0.12.6, pandoc 2.14, and standard coreutils.

config.filesystem_permissions: container has full read-write access to all paths
